fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures, including soft-404s where the article URL renders the homepage shell). Article-mode records (S1-html) carry headline/articleBody-style fields parsed from plain HTML (this CMS has no ld+json); latest-mode records (S2-rss) carry title/link-style fields from a per-section RSS feed.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (e.g. S1-html, S2-rss).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind (includes soft-404 cases where a nonexistent article URL returns HTTP 200 with the homepage shell).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

deck.title: Deck
deck.description: One-line subheading from header.inner-content > ul > li -- present on hard-news articles, absent on opinion/column pieces.

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description:
Full article text from header.inner-content

tags, with pull-image/caption widgets removed and paragraphs split on runs of
tags (this CMS mixes true

-per-paragraph markup with a single

using

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline from the RSS item (latest mode).

pubDate.title: Publish date
pubDate.description: RSS pubDate string, in this feed's non-standard format (e.g. 'Monday, 24 August 2026 06:28', not RFC 822) -- passed through as-is (latest mode).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
